items.heading: Buuz
details: Key ingredients: dumpling dough, mutton, onion
Mix minced mutton with finely chopped onion and a little water.
Wrap the filling in small dough rounds, pleating the tops closed.
Steam the dumplings until the dough is cooked through.
Serve hot, taking care as the filling holds heat and juices.

items.heading: Khorkhog
details: Key ingredients: mutton, hot stones, potato, carrot
Layer mutton pieces with vegetables in a large sealed pot.
Add heated stones directly among the meat.
Seal the pot and cook over a fire, shaking occasionally.
Serve the tender meat and vegetables once fully cooked through.
